## Summary

Remove the qr_code_server implementation from mcp-servers/python as it's no longer needed.

## Changes

- Removed qr_code_server directory and all its contents:
  - Server implementation and configuration
  - Tool implementations (decoder, generator, validator)

  - Container and build configuration
- Updated release management documentation

## Files Changed

- 31 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 5228 deletions(-)
- Deleted entire mcp-servers/python/qr_code_server/ directory
- Modified docs/docs/development/release-management.md

- All staged changes committed successfully

chore: remove qr_code_server from mcp-servers

Remove the qr_code_server implementation from mcp-servers/python as it's no longer needed. This includes:
- Server implementation and configuration
- Tool implementations (decoder, generator, validator)
- Utility modules (file_utils, image_utils)
- Test suite and fixtures
- Container and build configuration

Also update release management documentation to reflect this change.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
